rows.grounds: genitive plural of hīna (lacking) compounded with pūrṇābhiṣeka
neuter singular form used as the act in question

items.question: What consequence follows for one who drinks without full initiation?
premises: lacking full initiation changes ritual standing
drinking is the act under judgment
extreme bad state is the stated result
items.inference: The verse declares drinking by those without full initiation to be an extreme bad state.
uncertainties: whether pānam is subject or object in the larger sentence
exact gender of hīnānām in context
items.plain_english: For those lacking full initiation, drinking is an extreme bad state.
